user_problem: The same abbreviation expands differently across supplied contexts.
unique_output: Occurrence-to-possible-expansion guide with local evidence and unresolved ambiguity; no preferred-term replacement.
required_input: Abbreviation occurrences, context excerpts and an approved expansion glossary.
critical_rule: Context can narrow supplied options but cannot authorize an expansion absent from the glossary.
nearest_existing_and_difference: terminology-consistency-editor normalizes preferred terms; this disambiguates multiple allowed expansions without editing wording.
acceptance_scenario: AR allows accounts receivable or augmented reality; a headset context narrows to augmented reality, an unqualified AR note remains ambiguous.
